description: The p085 gate checks SDL/introspection for all GraphQL fields and enum domains named by contract rows. This fixture represents a failure where payloadUnavailableReasonCode is consumed by Swift via P031ArtifactReadModel.payloadUnavailableReasonCode but the SDL snapshot does not include its enum domain (PAYLOAD_DEFERRED_BY_P031, GENERATING, NOT_INDEXED, NOT_AUTHORIZED, NOT_AVAILABLE, UNKNOWN). Without schema proof, Swift presenters may depend on undocumented enum vocabulary.
hold_condition: The p085 gate must snapshot or introspect every field and enum domain consumed by the row matrix so Swift presenters do not depend on undocumented vocabulary.

missing_symbol.gate_check: p085 gate must verify this enum exists in SDL with at least these values before Swift decoding tests run

resolution: Add SDL introspection assertion for PayloadUnavailableReasonCode to the p085 gate or add the symbol to an existing schema snapshot referenced by the gate.
